In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

Resolve both Yahenni abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.

Activate one of the Tidewater Minion tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.

When All-Out Assault enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 3.

Play a land card from your hand.
Kodama, Trench Behemoth and Sporemound trigger.

When the three creatures die, Headless Rider triggers three times, creating three 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.

Reveillark triggers, returning Reveillark and any other valid target to the battlefield.

Repeat from step 4.
